$comment: Per-install values baked into the Studio build as unique placeholders and substituted at start by runtime/supavise-runtime-config.mjs. build.sh exports each placeholder as the build-time value of `env`, and fails if one does not survive into the build output. `kind`: url (http or https URL, trailing slash dropped), url-platform (same, and a missing /platform suffix is added), string, csp-hosts (list of host sources for the CSP). `origin` is the placeholder origin that appears alone in the CSP; it is replaced by the origin of the real URL.

values.doc: Management API as the browser reaches it, for example https://api.example.com/platform.
Dashboard GoTrue (supavise-gotrue@system) as the browser reaches it, including its path, for example https://api.example.com/auth/v1.
Public URL of the dashboard itself, for example https://studio.example.com. Used for redirect URLs.
hCaptcha site key. Empty (the default) renders no captcha widget (patch 0001).
Comma-separated feature keys to disable before login (patch 0002).
Host sources that serve project APIs, for example *.api.example.com (patch 0003). Each is allowed over https and wss, and also over http and ws when NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is an http URL.
Remote MCP endpoint shown in Connect > MCP, for example https://api.example.com/mcp.

Origin that serves Studio's ConfigCat flag document (/configuration-files/configcat-proxy/frontend-v2/config_v6.json), for example https://api.example.com. A node serves it from the Management API (internal/api/configcat.go); it is what shows the Include data switch of the Create branch dialog. Studio's CSP already allows the API origin, so no CSP entry is needed. Empty: Studio reads every flag as off.

The name of the server's GitHub App, as in github.com/apps/<name> (lib/github.ts). Studio falls back to Supabase's own App for an empty value, so a server without an App is given a name that belongs to nobody, and hides the GitHub surfaces (feature integrations:github, patch 0007).
The client id of the server's GitHub App, which the OAuth authorize window sends users to. Like the name it is never empty, because Studio would then use Supabase's own App.
